id.description: Exception list's identifier. Either `id` or `list_id` must be specified.

list_id.description: Human readable exception list string identifier, e.g. `trusted-linux-processes`. Either `id` or `list_id` must be specified.

namespace_type.description:
When `single`, the list is resolved in the current Kibana space. When `agnostic`, the list is a global
(space-agnostic) container. Required for looking up the correct list when `list_id` is not unique.
